BiblicalUsage: En-Tappuach is a place in Palestine. The name appears in Joshua (Joshua 17:7). It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Tappuach matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Tappuach is one of them.
